**Finding submitted: deviation (LICENSE), preferred target, one operation.**

- **Defect:** § 13.1 grants the subscription Services licence to "Customer alone," "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion," and expressly "without Affiliates or contractors." Since "Customer" is defined (p0001) as Meridian Fieldworks only, our Affiliates have no coverage and no path to be added — walk-away territory and a failure of the fallback.
- **Already met elsewhere:** § 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable paid-up licence to Customer and its Affiliates; § 13.3 (with § 24.1) permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor in an M&A transaction.
- **Cure:** a single surgical replacement of the 13.1 grant sentence extending it to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and replacing discretionary revocation with the uncured-material-breach standard already in 13.3, which also removes the "non-transferable" conflict with 13.3. Minimality gate returned ok:true.
